description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of ethical principles discussed within the MedEthicsQA dataset. The chart contains ten slices, each representing a different ethical principle. The slices are labeled “Respect Life, Dignity of Patients,” “Respect and Cooperate with Colleagues,” “Provide Assistance in Emergency,” “Provide Medical Care to Patients,” “Continual Learning,” “Comply with Laws and Regulations,” “Promote Justice,” “Beneficence,” “Non-Maleficence,” and “Autonomy.” The colors of the slices are varied, ranging from shades of blue and green to orange and red. Approximate proportions, visually estimated, are as follows: “Respect Life, Dignity of Patients” (22%), “Respect and Cooperate with Colleagues” (14%), “Provide Assistance in Emergency” (8%), “Provide Medical Care to Patients” (8%), “Continual Learning” (8%), “Comply with Laws and Regulations” (8%), “Promote Justice” (8%), “Beneficence” (8%), “Non-Maleficence” (8%), and “Autonomy” (16%). The chart includes a legend identifying each principle with its corresponding color. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, with no obvious ordering by size.
